fields.description: The Pinnacle is the final and tallest tower in Sobha Central’s six-tower masterplan along Sheikh Zayed Road. Its one- and two-bedroom apartments place compact layouts above a mixed residential, retail and leisure setting.

overview: The brochure combines residential towers with offices, retail and shared recreation. Pools, outdoor sports and social lawns are community amenities; confirm delivery, permitted access and service charges for the chosen tower.
research.locationNote: Within Sobha Central on Sheikh Zayed Road. Confirm the actual entrance, pedestrian transport route and orientation; illustrated access and views are not guarantees for every apartment.
research.priceNote: Sobha advertises apartments from AED 1.78m, subject to inventory. Obtain a current dated unit quotation; advertised resale incentives are not project-wide pricing.
research.paymentNote: Bayut reports 60% before completion and 40% at handover. Schmidt & Partner divides the former into 20% booking and 40% construction. These are reported stages; dates, eligibility and fees require a current developer offer.
research.handoverNote: Bayut gives Q4 2030 and the broker December 2030. No signed developer programme was retrieved; this remains a reported estimate.

facts.label: Layout distinction
facts.value: The one-bedroom Type A drawing includes a utility niche and balcony. The cited two-bedroom types add a powder room. Printed saleable totals include balcony space.

unresolved: No current inventory, project-wide unit count, service charge, parking allocation or signed handover/payment calendar was retrieved.
Selected drawings are examples, not development-wide size limits. Plans permit changes and show illustrative furnishings.
Shared infrastructure, transport access and facilities require phase-specific confirmation. Photos remain illustrative.
